spec_theorems.name: run_stdout_eq_count
spec_theorems.informal: With the line-count option over standard input, stdout is exactly one decimal field: the number of input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: For this successful standard-input line-counting mode, the utility exits with status 0.

spec_theorems.name: run_stdout_has_one_line
spec_theorems.informal: Because no filename or totals are written in this scope, the utility emits exactly one output line.

spec_theorems.name: run_independent_of_args
spec_theorems.informal: In the modeled scope, only standard input is read and no file name is written, so the result is independent of argv details.

spec_theorems.name: run_append_counts_all_input_lines
spec_theorems.informal: The reported line count for combined standard input is the sum of the counts of the input parts.
